proposition: Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī gave Ibn Turka and his circle the derisive label naw-mulḥidān (neo-bāṭinīs, even neo-Ismaʿilis); MK is unsure whether it means freethinking subversives or Ismaʿilis.

mediation.where: cited by MK from Binbaş, Sharaf al-Dīn, 124-29
mediation.note: a hostile label from an opponent
